connector.name: Woocommerce MCP
connector.registryDescription: Read-only MCP server for WordPress + WooCommerce products, orders, sales, and posts.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package woocommerce-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the wppoland account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: WP_URL
env.description: Base URL of the WordPress / WooCommerce store (HTTPS)

env.name: WC_CONSUMER_KEY
env.description: WooCommerce REST API consumer key (Read permission)

env.name: WC_CONSUMER_SECRET
env.description: WooCommerce REST API consumer secret (Read permission)
